title: Code and data for: Did a tourism ban clear the water? A satellite-based counterfactual assessment of nearshore turbidity at Saint Martin's Island, Bay of Bengal
description:
Google Earth Engine scripts, Python scripts and derived data supporting the article Did a tourism ban clear the water? A satellite-based counterfactual assessment of nearshore turbidity at Saint Martin's Island, Bay of Bengal.

The record contains the study zones, zonal Sentinel-2 turbidity and red-reflectance time series (2017–2026), environmental predictors (ERA5, CHIRPS, GOT4.10 tides), VIIRS night-light series, modelling tables and all analysis outputs needed to reproduce the numbers, tables and figures of the article. See README.md for the workflow and instructions.
